lines.text: Hiram rejoices and promises to haul the logs from Lebanon to the Sea and float them as rafts.
Solomon sends Hiram 20,000 cors of wheat and 20,000 baths of pure olive oil once, and they make a treaty.
Solomon has 70,000 porters and 80,000 stonecutters, and only Israelites quarry large stones for the temple foundation.

wrong_details.true: Solomon's and Hiram's builders, with the Gebalites, quarried
